manifest.purpose: paired continuation training data; not evidence of model improvement

budget.odd_token_policy: if total is odd, ordinary receives the single extra token

manifest.supervision: retain first cap supervised tokens in time order; cap=min(clean,recovery,pool budget remaining); keep entire input context
manifest.pairing: same source questions, record order, repeat counts and per-record supervision in A/C; ordinary records identical
manifest.training_instruction: one epoch over each pretokenized file; same seed, batch size and accumulation; do not independently resample or retokenize
manifest.scope: formal training only; no development or holdout data accessed
manifest.limitations: Recovery records are reused when scarce. Repetition is not additional independent coverage; input tokens and compute are not matched.

statistics.primary: Per question, mean of C-minus-A correctness across both continuation seeds; then mean across questions
statistics.uncertainty: Paired percentile bootstrap of 2000 question units, retaining both seed outcomes together
statistics.secondary: Each seed C versus A and C versus P; all five accuracies and inference costs
statistics.subgroups: Fixed reference-length, qualifier, set-operation and numeric/comparison groups; descriptive only
statistics.limitations: Conditional on two continuation checkpoints sharing the initial model and corpus; no training-seed uncertainty; 2000 question units, not 4000; token counts are not FLOPs
statistics.after_results: Report all fixed models and outcomes; no tuning, checkpoint selection, or automatic next round

method: Matched-supervision real-failure recovery SFT versus clean continuation; both fixed continuation seeds, shared initial adapter; P is the contextual program baseline
schedule: Four agent models concurrently, then P on GPU0; no automatic analysis
timeout_note: Existing supervisor polling and shutdown can add seconds of overhead
gold_policy: Hash/parse questions at run; hash/parse answers only in explicit analyze after all five complete outputs are bound
execution_audit: During explicit analyze, replay all 8000 agent trajectories and re-execute all emitted P programs using questions only; save audit and require zero differences before gold access
